description: This file defines an interface ITransactionFaultInjector with methods for fault injection during transaction processing, specifically for storing operations.

classes.name: ITransactionFaultInjector
classes.description: An interface for injecting faults into transaction store operations, with methods to be invoked before and after store actions.

methods.name: BeforeStore
methods.description: Method to be called before a store operation to inject faults or perform pre-processing.

methods.name: AfterStore
methods.description: Method to be called after a store operation to inject faults or perform post-processing.
